title: 3165. Maximum Sum of Subsequence With Non-adjacent Elements

examples.explanation: After the 1st query, nums = [3,-2,9] and the maximum sum of a subsequence with non-adjacent elements is 3 + 9 = 12. After the 2nd query, nums = [-3,-2,9] and the maximum sum of a subsequence with non-adjacent elements is 9.
After the 1st query, nums = [-5,-1] and the maximum sum of a subsequence with non-adjacent elements is 0 (choosing an empty subsequence).
